title: Invasive Pythons Are Wiping Out Everglades Mammals
hook: One caught in 2023 was longer than a giraffe is tall.
closing: The raccoons never stood a chance.
question: Would you go looking for a 19-foot python?

segments.say: In parts of the Everglades, raccoon sightings dropped 99 percent after Burmese pythons moved in.
Florida pays hunters to catch invasive pythons. Removals jumped to 1,022 in summer 2025, up sharply.
One python caught in 2023 measured 19 feet, about as long as a giraffe is tall.
